review.method: Separately authored agent source-reviewed holdout. Questions written without reading generator templates or runtime alias dictionaries. Expectations use public knowledge records and approved GES source facts; not independent human annotation.
review.caveat: This is a fixed diagnostic holdout, not an unbiased real-user sample. Expected sources allow verified duplicate pages. No expectations were learned from current engine replies.
annotationReviewAdjustments: Phone questions require the requested number, not an unrequested email.
Working-week assertions accept the source abbreviations Sun/Thu.
Parents passport checklist is also sourced by the public enrollment form; online application directions are also sourced by admissions step 2.
